Name: Bregs Crafting
Author: Bregodon
Description:
[color=#ffd966][size=3][b]Bregs Crafting is a slightly harder and balanced overhaul of all craftable items.[/b][/size][/color]

[size=3]The goal is to increase the required resources for craftables to make the game experience more challenging.
The required resources stay in vanilla-like balance to preserve the beloved Stardew Valley feeling.[/size]

[color=#93c47d][size=3][b]Compatible with SDV 1.6[/b][/size][/color]

----------
[size=3]
[color=#6d9eeb][b]Features[/b][/color][/size]

[list]
[*][size=3]all craftables change required resources[/size]
[*][size=3]organized in categories (can be toggled on/off)[/size]
[*][size=3]sprinklers rebalanced[/size]
[*][color=#b6b6b6][size=3][i]optional: upgradeable sprinklers fully integrated[/i][/size][/color]
[*][size=3]paths are cheaper than floors[/size]
[*][size=3]all braziers require 1 coal and 5 fiber as fuel[/size]
[*][size=3]seeds, tackles, consumables & rings are unchanged for max. mod compatibility[/size]
[/list]
